title: Name 10 Atletico Madrid players from 2025/26
brief: Name any ten players who played at least one La Liga game for Atletico Madrid in 2025/26.

notes._miss: Played for another La Liga club in 2025/26, or did not play a league game for Atletico Madrid that season.
